blog_title: DTF Order Form Pieces vs Sheets Explained — Why 1 Piece Means a Full Print Sheet, Not 1 T-Shirt
caption:
🤔 **DTF में 'Pieces' का सवाल?**

'Pieces' मतलब T-shirts नहीं—पूरी sheet है जो print होती है। अगर आप 22.8 inch चौड़ी sheet भेजते हो, तो '2 pieces' = वही sheet 2 बार print होगी। कीमत = sheet की असली height × pieces। ❌ गलती: हर design के लिए अलग sheet बनाना = कीमत बढ़ जाएगी। ✅ सही: एक sheet पर सब designs को साथ लगाएं (gang sheet)।

अपने order में कितने designs एक sheet पर fit कर सकते हो?

editorial_review.reason: All substantive claims are backed by reviewed primary sources: (1) 'Pieces' means whole sheet repetitions, not individual T-shirts — supported by dtf_pieces_whole_sheet source (dtf.bulkplaintshirt.com/about, checked 2026-10-03); (2) Price formula sheet height × pieces — same source; (3) Sheet dimensions 22.8 inches wide — supported by dtf_sheet_size source (checked 2026-10-05); (4) Gang sheet concept (multiple designs on one sheet) — supported by dtf_single_designs and dtf_sheet_size sources; (5) Error of separate sheets per design increases cost — logical inference from pricing formula, supported. The caption teaches one clear buyer lesson (correct ordering method to avoid cost increases) without invented prices, guarantees, or unverified claims. Hindi explanation matches English source facts. No diagnostic shortcuts, universal settings, or customer stories added.
